cards.speaker: src_telegram
cards.text: COMPANY TO KEEPER STOP REDUCE LOCK HANDS BY ONE FOR ECONOMY STOP NAME TO FOLLOW BY POST STOP

left.label: Comply; choose the newest hand
left.outcome: A young man goes down the flight with a reference.

right.label: Reply that the gate needs every hand
right.outcome: No reply for a week. Then a different order.

cards.speaker: pell
cards.text: Keeper! The Board would like a photograph of the summit for the Jubilee brochure. The plate-man needs the chamber empty and still for a quarter hour. In daylight. On a working day.

left.label: A quarter hour for the Company
left.outcome: The plate shows an empty lock and a Superintendent. It is much admired.

right.label: At dawn, before the boats
right.outcome: The plate is dark and moody. Pell is in it anyway.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: A Board directive: Keepers are to report any 'unusual interest' in Company structures by persons unknown. For the record, that includes the sluice house. For the record, I did not write it.

left.label: Acknowledge it
left.outcome: "Noted." She does not ask if you have any to report.

right.label: Ask why the sluice house
right.outcome: "Because it is on the list. You will find lists are not explained."

cards.speaker: kell
cards.text: Ambrose Kell, Commissioner. The Board's view is that the summit is a Company asset and its Keeper a Company servant. I say this at every lock. I find it saves time later.

left.label: Understood, Commissioner
left.outcome: "Excellent. Regrettably few say so."

right.label: The town is not an asset
right.outcome: "The Board's view differs. I shall note yours."

cards.speaker: fennick
cards.text: I shouldn't, but: a wire came for Vosk, not you, and it said 'CONTAIN' and then your name. Just that. I sent it on. I'm telling you because I like you. Please don't tell her I like you.

left.label: Thank him; say nothing
left.outcome: You watch Vosk at supper. She eats as she always eats.

right.label: Tell him to stop reading wires
right.outcome: "I can't. It's the job. The reading's the job."

cards.speaker: src_telegram
cards.text: COMPANY TO KEEPER STOP CONFIRM RESERVOIR LEVELS NORMAL FOR SEASON STOP REPLY BY RETURN STOP

left.label: CONFIRMED
left.outcome: You did not check. Nobody expects you to have checked.

right.label: UNABLE TO CONFIRM STOP AQUEDUCT LOW
right.outcome: Silence. Then Vosk, at your door, not smiling.

cards.speaker: pell
cards.text: The Board has asked me to remind Keepers that fraternizing with the boat-clans is 'discouraged'. I do not make these rules, Keeper. I do pass them on, with a certain vigor.

left.label: Understood
left.outcome: Bram hears of it by nightfall. He hears of everything.

right.label: Discouraged is not forbidden
right.outcome: "A lawyer's answer, Keeper. I shall pretend I did not hear it."

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: Quarterly inspection. I will need the Book, the chest, the keys and two hours. You will find it goes faster if you do not watch.

left.label: Leave her to it
left.outcome: Two hours. "Noted." Nothing more.

right.label: Watch anyway
right.outcome: Two hours and a half. She notes that you watched.

cards.speaker: kell
cards.text: The Board would like the Keeper to sign a statement that the summit's water supply is 'adequate and well managed'. It is a formality. Regrettably, formalities are what the Board runs on.

left.label: Sign it
left.outcome: Your name, under a sentence you did not write, about water you do not understand.

right.label: Ask to read the supply figures first
right.outcome: "They are in Ardent. Regrettably." He does not press. He remembers.

cards.speaker: fennick
cards.text: You'll never guess who's asked for a copy of your traffic wires. The Sorrel Courier. In strictest confidence I can say I haven't sold them. In strictest confidence I could.

left.label: Don't
left.outcome: "Right. No. Of course not." He is a little disappointed in himself.

right.label: Sell them; share the coin
right.outcome: Hesse prints your figures. Pell is thrilled until he reads the headline.

cards.speaker: src_telegram
cards.text: COMPANY TO KEEPER STOP CLEARANCE ORDER OF YEAR 44 UNDER REVIEW STOP KEEPER TO REPORT NUMBER OF HULLFOLK VESSELS AT SUMMIT STOP

left.label: Report the true number
left.outcome: Forty-one. The wire goes to Ardent and does not come back.

right.label: Report 'variable; not counted'
right.outcome: Vosk, later: "Noted. It was a kind lie."

cards.speaker: pell
cards.text: A commendation, Keeper! From the Board itself, for 'steady management of the summit'. I have had it framed. I have had two framed. One is for you.

left.label: Hang it in the toll office
left.outcome: Bargees read it while they wait. Some of them laugh.

right.label: Hang it in the inn
right.outcome: Ilse hangs it behind the bar, upside down. It becomes a landmark.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: The Board asks whether the Keeper has had 'unsupervised contact' with the engineer's survey papers. For the record, I have already answered. I would like to know if I answered correctly.

left.label: You answered correctly
left.outcome: "Good." She does not say what she answered.

right.label: What did you answer?
right.outcome: "No. I answered no." She holds your eye.

cards.speaker: kell
cards.text: The Board has reviewed the Keeper's decisions this quarter and finds them 'independent'. I should tell you that in the Board's vocabulary this is not a compliment. It is not yet a dismissal.

left.label: I serve the gate
left.outcome: "The Board's view is that you serve the Board. Regrettably, it is also mine."

right.label: I shall be less independent
right.outcome: "Excellent." He does not believe you, and does not need to.

cards.speaker: fennick
cards.text: Vosk asked me today whether I keep copies. I said no. I kept a copy of her asking. I don't know why I do this. Should I burn them? All of them? Tell me to.

left.label: Burn them
left.outcome: He burns them in the telegraph stove. He keeps one. You both know.

right.label: Keep them somewhere safer
right.outcome: "The Ledger? You mean the Ledger." He does not wait for an answer.

cards.speaker: src_telegram
cards.text: COMPANY TO KEEPER STOP PROVIDE LIST OF TOWNSFOLK EMPLOYED AT LOCK WITH POLITICAL SYMPATHIES IF KNOWN STOP

left.label: Send the list, sympathies blank
left.outcome: Names without opinions. Ardent files it anyway.

right.label: Sympathies are not the Company's business
right.outcome: Ilse hears you refused. The town hears Ilse.

cards.speaker: pell
cards.text: The Courier has printed that Halfway's Superintendent 'presides over a slow decline'. Slow, Keeper. Decline. I would like a record week to answer it. I would like it very much.

left.label: Give him his record week
left.outcome: Boats through at all hours. The gauge pays for it.

right.label: Answer him with a letter instead
right.outcome: Pell writes nine pages. Hesse prints one paragraph.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: The Board proposes closing the summit to Hullfolk moorings 'pending review'. It asks for the Keeper's recommendation. You will find I have not given mine. I am waiting for yours.

left.label: Recommend against
left.outcome: "Noted." A pause. "So have I."

right.label: Recommend closure
right.outcome: "Noted." Nothing else. Pell is delighted.

cards.speaker: kell
cards.text: I shall be at the summit for a week, observing. The Board's view is that observation improves performance. My own view is that it improves reports. Do carry on.

left.label: Carry on exactly as usual
left.outcome: A week of being watched. Nothing changes, which he notes.

right.label: Show him the town, too
right.outcome: He drinks at the Wheel once, stiffly. Ilse charges him double.

cards.speaker: fennick
cards.text: Something odd on the wire tonight: Ardent to Vosk, numbers only, forty groups. Not the traffic code. Not any code I know. I've never seen her get one like it. She burned it. She never burns anything.

left.label: Did you keep a copy?
left.outcome: "I shouldn't have. Yes." Forty groups you cannot read. Yet.

right.label: Not our business
right.outcome: "No. No, of course." He looks at the stove.
